reading.body:
Microsoft operates PHX-11 as part of a multi-building campus in Goodyear, Arizona, within the Phoenix metropolitan region. The company does not publish power capacity, square footage, or exact addresses for individual Azure data center campuses, disclosing only aggregate figures globally: 40+ gigawatts of renewable energy contracted across 500+ datacenters in 80+ regions worldwide. This policy means PHX-11's contribution to Microsoft's footprint cannot be quantified from public sources.

Arizona has 56 mapped data center facilities in this registry, of which only 4 operators publish megawatt capacity. The state totals 512 MW of published capacity across those four sites. PHX-11 ranks fifth in published MW within Arizona, which indicates Microsoft has not released a figure for this campus; the four published sites belong to other operators.

The Goodyear campus has expanded materially: Microsoft purchased an additional 100 acres adjacent to its existing footprint to extend capacity. Without published power specifications, PHX-11's role in Microsoft's AI infrastructure strategy and its effect on Arizona's grid constraints cannot be assessed from disclosed facts alone. The campus qualifies as a production Azure data center capable of hosting enterprise cloud workloads, but the scale of AI-specific deployment remains undisclosed.
